note: Your organization's name. Example: Maple Street Food Bank
One plain sentence about what you provide. Example: Free groceries every Tuesday and Saturday
Who your customers or neighbors are. Example: Families and seniors in the east side of town
The town or region. Example: Springfield and nearby villages
Other places your customers might go instead (separate with commas). Example: Other pantries; church meal programs
Two to five phrases a customer might type into a search box (separate with commas). Example: food pantry; free groceries
How many seed terms the Apps Script pulls per run (keep at five or fewer)
The address that gets a message if a scheduled pull fails. Example: name@example.org
